The main topic of the text is the **ketogenic diet**, specifically focusing on its role as a weight loss strategy, its purported benefits (reduced appetite, improved metabolism), and potential risks (nutritional deficiencies, side effects).

Regarding the second part of your request, the primary material of a candle is **wax** (such as paraffin, beeswax, soy, or palm wax), which serves as the fuel source. A candle also typically contains a **wick** (usually made of cotton or paper) that draws the melted wax up to the flame via capillary action.
